ops.title: Reconcile converges helper agents, not only install
ops.description: serviceAgents() is called only from install() (daemon/install.go:94); the 15-minute reconcile never re-derives helper programs. After a helper binary upgrade, the LaunchAgent points at a stale or deleted path until someone manually re-runs synckitd install — there is no self-healing. Reconcile should converge helper agents too (re-derive programs, or detect stale/deleted Program paths and re-stage). Found 2026-07-26 during the helper-plist fix wave; bites hardest combined with versioned Caskroom paths (see the .app deployment-package task and daemonkit 74be91d7).

ops.text: After a helper binary changes on disk, reconcile converges the helper agent without a manual synckitd install
